note: Conventions the instrument metadata does not express. Anything the API returns per-instrument is read from metadata instead and never duplicated here.

expiry.note: All dated contracts expire at this time. validate_expiry_convention checks live metadata agrees.

settlement.note: Settlement index is a time-weighted average over the window ending at expiry.

option.note: Charged on the underlying, capped at cap_fraction_of_premium of the option price. Per-instrument rates from metadata override the rates here; the cap has no metadata field.
